title: The Only TV on Our Street
audience: Ethiopians aged 18-35, in Ethiopia and the diaspora, who grew up in a sefer (neighbourhood) in the 2000s-2010s, and young parents raising children among screens today. They watch on phones, on TikTok, Telegram and Facebook, think in Amharic and remember Gemena night.
intent: They should feel the warmth of a shared childhood they recognise as their own, understand that playing together is how children learn to get along with people, and want to send their own children (or younger siblings) outside to play.

style.description: Warm hand-painted illustration, soft painterly brushwork, gentle film grain, nostalgic golden late-afternoon light, earthy palette of ochre, rust, faded turquoise and eucalyptus green, soft depth of field, an Addis Ababa neighbourhood of the early 2010s with corrugated tin roofs, painted metal gates and dirt alleys
style.negative: text, letters, subtitles, watermark, logo, brand names, extra fingers, distorted faces, modern skyscrapers, smartphones in the 2010s scenes

characters.name: Young me
characters.description: an Ethiopian girl about nine years old with warm dark-brown skin, a round face, big bright eyes, short natural hair in two puff buns tied with red bands, wearing a faded yellow cotton dress with a small white collar and blue plastic sandals

characters.name: Neighbourhood children
characters.description: a small group of Ethiopian neighbourhood children aged seven to eleven: a tall thin boy with dark-brown skin in a faded red football shirt, a small boy with dark-brown skin and short black hair in a blue knitted sweater, and a girl with thin braids in a green dress

voice.style_prompt: Read this Amharic line slowly and warmly, like a young woman fondly remembering her childhood, smiling, with small natural pauses:

music.prompt: acoustic, organic, ethio-jazz, East African folk, plucked lyre, bowed single-string fiddle, wooden flute, hand drums, pentatonic melody, tizita, nostalgic, warm, gentle, playful, childhood memories, slow build then soft resolve, no synthesizer, no electronic drums

lines: For the kids of our sefer, and every Gemena night we shared.
Made with AI: images, motion, music and the narrator's voice are AI-generated from my own childhood story, told with my consent.

shots.purpose: Establish the place before any person: the sefer the whole story lives in, with one antenna standing out as a quiet setup for the TV.
shots.image_prompt: High wide view over a dense Addis Ababa neighbourhood in late-afternoon light, rows of rusty corrugated tin roofs, eucalyptus trees, narrow dirt alleys, laundry lines, one roof in the middle with a tall television antenna catching the sun
shots.motion_prompt: smoke drifts from a chimney, laundry sways, birds cross the sky, light shimmers on the tin roofs

shots.purpose: Introduce young me among friends, so the audience bonds with a child and a group, not a landscape.
shots.image_prompt: Children playing skipping rope in a narrow dirt alley between painted metal gates: the two boys each hold one end of a long rope swinging in an arc while the girl in the yellow dress jumps over it mid-air, the girl in green claps, dust glowing in golden light
shots.motion_prompt: the rope swings, the girl jumps and lands laughing, the children clap, dust rises softly

narration.text: ከጎረቤት ልጆች ጋር እየተጫወትን ነው ያደግነው።
narration.translation_en: I grew up playing with the neighbours' children.

shots.purpose: Make the joy of play specific and personal: a close moment of hide-and-seek.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of one single girl, alone, hiding behind a rusty blue corrugated tin fence, peeking out with a hand over her mouth to stop herself laughing, warm side light
shots.motion_prompt: she leans out to peek, giggles behind her hand, her puff buns bounce, then she ducks back

shots.purpose: The turn of the story: one house has what everyone else lacks.
shots.image_prompt: Dusk in the neighbourhood, a modest house with a tall television antenna on its roof and warm light spilling from its open doorway, children running down the alley toward it
shots.motion_prompt: the children run toward the lit doorway, the sky darkens from orange to blue, the antenna sways slightly

narration.text: በሰፈራችን ቴሌቪዥን የነበረው አንድ ቤት ብቻ ነበር።
narration.translation_en: In our neighbourhood, only one house had a television.

shots.purpose: The ritual at the heart of the memory: the whole sefer gathered in one small room for Gemena.
shots.image_prompt: Indoors, inside a small cosy living room at night with plastered walls and a curtain over the door, many children sitting close together on a woven mat on the floor, sandals piled by the door, all faces turned toward a small old box television on a wooden stand seen from behind, its cool glow lighting their faces
shots.motion_prompt: the television glow flickers on the children's faces, a small child squeezes in to sit, someone shushes the others

narration.text: ሁሌም ተሰብስበን የገመናን ድራማ አንድ ላይ እናይ ነበር።
narration.translation_en: We would all gather and watch the drama Gemena together.

shots.purpose: A silent beat: let the audience sit inside the feeling of watching, no words needed.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the girl's face in a dark room, lit only by the soft blue-white glow of a television, wide-eyed and holding her breath, both hands pressed to her cheeks
shots.motion_prompt: the glow flickers, her eyes widen, she gasps softly and grips her cheeks

shots.purpose: What the TV really gave them: talking together afterwards, the start of connection.
shots.image_prompt: Night in the dirt alley, four children (the girl in yellow, the girl in green, the boy in red, the boy in blue) walking home together under a single warm street lamp, talking excitedly and gesturing with their hands, moths around the lamp
shots.motion_prompt: the children walk slowly, waving their hands as they argue and laugh, moths flutter around the lamp

narration.text: ከዛ በኋላ ደግሞ ስለ ድራማው እንነጋገር ነበር።
narration.translation_en: And afterwards, we would talk about the drama.

shots.purpose: Jump to today: the grown narrator looks back with joy, not regret; shown only from behind, so no real likeness.
shots.image_prompt: Present day, a young adult woman seen from behind, a white netela over her shoulders, standing on a rooftop at golden hour looking down over the same neighbourhood of tin roofs, newer buildings on the horizon
shots.motion_prompt: her shawl moves in the breeze, the sun lowers, birds circle over the roofs

narration.text: አሁን ልጅነቴን ሳስብ ደስ ይለኛል እንጂ አይቆጨኝም።
narration.translation_en: Now, when I think of my childhood, I feel joy, not regret.

shots.purpose: The lesson made visible: a child alone with a screen indoors, while play happens just outside the window.
shots.image_prompt: Present day, inside a modern apartment living room, a small Ethiopian child sitting alone on a sofa in the dim room, face lit by the cold glow of a tablet, while through the bright window behind, children play together in the sunlit street
shots.motion_prompt: the tablet glow flickers on the child's face, outside the window children run and laugh, curtains move slightly

narration.text: በተጫወቱ ልጆችና ባልተጫወቱ ልጆች መካከል ትልቅ ልዩነት አለ። ተጫውተው ያላደጉ ልጆች ከሰው ጋር መግባባት ይከብዳቸዋል።
narration.translation_en: There is a big difference between children who played and those who didn't. Children who never played find it hard to get along with people.

shots.purpose: Resolve on hope and a call to action: children of today running out to play, echoing shot s02.
shots.image_prompt: Present day, a joyful group of Ethiopian children running and laughing down a sunlit neighbourhood alley, a plastic football in mid-air, golden light, dust glowing
shots.motion_prompt: the children run toward the camera laughing, the ball bounces, dust swirls in the light
